cases.sentence: Я был вашим вождем с юности до ___.
cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my youth to this day.

cases.sentence: Итак, встаньте здесь, а я буду судиться с вами перед Господом о всех ___ Господа, которые Он совершил для вас и ваших отцов.
cases.explain: «спасительных делах» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before Yahweh concerning all the righteous acts of Yahweh, which he did to you and to your fathers.

cases.sentence: Помните, какие ___ Он для вас совершил.
cases.explain: «великие дела» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Only fear Yahweh, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.
